title: Saturation I_A = N log2 not established (balanced+independent vs deterministic conflict)

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
Theorem 'Imax-discrete' tightness claims $I_A=N\log2$ via $D_k=\phi(X_{t_k})$ balanced and 'conditionally independent given the past'.

(1) For $H(D)=N\log2$ one needs each $D_k$ uniform AND conditionally independent of $D_{<k}$. But $X_{t_k}$ is a Markov diffusion whose closed-loop law depends on $D_{<k}$, so the $D_k$ are generally correlated; balancing the marginal via threshold re-randomisation does not give conditional independence.
(2) Making the marginal exactly balanced by external randomisation forces $H(D\mid X)>0$, contradicting the simultaneous requirement $H(D\mid X)=0$ used for $I_A=H(D)$.

Tension between 'balanced+independent' (needs randomisation) and 'deterministic in X' (needs none) is unresolved; no protocol meeting both is exhibited, so $I_A=N\log2$ is asserted, not proved.
